div.h1: MCP Apps + durable state on Cloudflare
div.p: The tenant authenticates the client. Access identifies the human. The store keys on the human.

text.tspan: never /token — there is no browser there

g.text: Durable Objects — one per human, addressed by idFromName(sub)

text.tspan: each with their own Access identity
per-user delegation is what makes the profile work
identity rides the refresh token too
